requirement_text: Achieving a minimum of 480 points and meeting the minimum entry requirements for the programme in the same sitting of the Irish Leaving Certificate Examination (or equivalent) and completing the required admissions test (HPAT-Ireland). The score achieved in the HPAT-Ireland examination will be added to the Leaving Certificate points to create a total point's score for admission.

requirement_text: To enter the University of Galway, you need an IELTS score of at least 6.5 overall, with no section below 6.0 (higher for some programmes, e.g. 7.0/6.0 for literature/publishing, English, media/communications and journalism). TOEFL iBT (tests before 21 Jan 2026): 88 overall (L18, R18, S21, W22); TOEFL iBT (exams on/after 21 Jan 2026): minimum overall TOEFL score of 4.5 [on the redesigned scale]. Pearson PTE Academic: 63 overall, no less than 59 in any one component. Cambridge CAE/CPE: 176 overall, not less than 169 in each element.

limitations: TOEFL post-21-Jan-2026 minimum is stated on the source page as 'minimum overall TOEFL score of 4.5', consistent with a redesigned/rescaled TOEFL iBT that Maynooth University's and UCC's own English-requirement pages separately and independently describe taking effect around the same January 2026 date -- cross-confirmed across 3 of the 4 institutions in this research pass, so not treated as an extraction artifact.

requirement_text: Non-EU applicants to all undergraduate degree programmes other than Medicine apply directly through the International Affairs Office. Students applying for undergraduate medicine should apply directly to the School of Medicine. Required documents include school transcripts/examination certificates (or forecast/predicted results if not yet complete), a personal statement (maximum 800 words, mandatory), two letters of recommendation, and English proficiency evidence. For US applicants, SAT (code 5878) or ACT (code 5351) scores are recommended. An application fee of €35 applies (you may apply for up to two programmes).
